gold_note: Ancestor-descendant diagram, read by eye. P. andrewsi sits on the main line where P. hellenikorhinus branches off, and is read as a child of that node (as for tips at a node in earlier batches), giving a three-way node. The vertical line from Bag. rozhdestvenskyi up to an unlabelled circle at the Baruungoyot level is read as the same taxon's range, not a further tip. The character lists and skull drawings are not encoded. 4 tips, 1 polytomies (3 children). Sample 7 case (census 2, seed 20261241).
